label.capnotice: This run will process only {{cap}} of {{total}} bookmarks (AI session cap).
label.nobookmarks: No bookmarks found in this folder — select a folder first
label.reusedest: Use the destination's existing structure as a guide
label.deleteempty: Delete empty folders left behind after organizing
label.consider_existing: Consider existing folders (reuse what's already there)

hint.profile: Optional: apply a learned organizational philosophy
hint.reusedest: Only applies when the destination is different from the source folder
hint.consider_existing: When off, the previous folder structure is discarded and the AI reorganizes from scratch using only the selected profile
hint.maxfolder: Soft limit: folders above ~this many items (bookmarks + subfolders) are split into balanced subfolders; groups near the limit stay together and single-item folders are merged.
hint.minfolder: New folders created by this run with fewer than this many bookmarks are merged into the closest sibling folder (or moved one level up). Prevents folders with a single bookmark. Existing folders are respected.

error.noconfig: No AI configuration found. Go to Bookmarks > AI Settings to set up your API key first.
error.nocontext_content: Open this window from a folder in the main window first.
error.nomoves_content: No bookmarks have accepted moves. Toggle moves or use Accept All first.

progress.quota_minute: The per-minute API limit was reached. Retrying in {{wait}}s (attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}}). You can leave this window open — it will continue on its own.
progress.quota_daily: The free daily quota has been exhausted. It resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window with peace of mind — nothing has been changed and no bookmarks have been lost.
progress.quota_stopped: The run was stopped because the API quota is still exhausted after a full retry wait. This is very likely the daily limit — it resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window with peace of mind — nothing has been changed and no bookmarks have been lost.

summary.proposed: Proposed moving {{moved}} of {{total}} bookmarks into {{new}} new and {{existing}} existing folders.
summary.quota_box: ⚠ The run was stopped by the API quota. Only {{moved}} of {{total}} bookmarks were classified — the remaining {{left}} were NOT processed and remain untouched on the server. The quota resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window — nothing else has been changed.
summary.quota_box_done: ⚠ Classification finished ({{moved}} of {{total}} bookmarks), but the rebalancing pass was stopped by the API quota. The proposal below is complete and you can still apply it — however, folders were NOT rebalanced to the configured maximum, so some may hold more items than the limit. Nothing has been changed on the server yet.
summary.api_calls_stopped: This run made {{n}} API calls before the API quota stopped it.
summary.mechanical: ℹ The AI rebalancing pass was cut short, so {{count}} overfull folder(s) were balanced without AI (grouped by website/domain).

done.title: Auto-Organize Complete
done.noempty: No empty folders were found in this scope.

emptyfolders.message: The reorganization left {{count}} empty folder(s). Delete them?
emptyfolders.note: Note: any empty subfolders nested inside these will also be removed.

status.scanned: Run complete — review the proposed moves below.
status.applied: Moves applied to the server ({{count}} bookmarks).
status.cancelled: Operation cancelled — no changes were applied.
